Capabilities

Engineered for Spatial & Tactile Work

Andromeda is not a standard web chatbot. It is an edge-native desktop operating layer built with tactile hardware controls.

Spatial Agent & Desktop Bridges

Native Linux D-Bus MPRIS and PulseAudio integration. Andromeda controls desktop music (Spotify, VLC, browser), sets volumes, and coordinates host desktop processes.

MPRIS PulseAudio D-Bus

Multi-Tier Inference Grid

Dynamic hot-switching between Local Qwen-2.5 1.5B (SQR FP8 edge execution), LAN Bridge 7B Turbo on OptiPlex, and Google Gemini Cloud fallback for complex reasoning.

Ollama 1.5B Edge 7B Turbo LAN

Unified Containerized SQLite3

All user records, passwords (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 salted), session tokens, and conversations are stored in a single high-performance `andromeda.db` volume with Write-Ahead Logging.

SQLite3 WAL PBKDF2 100k User Scoped

Astigmatism-Ergonomic UI

Calibrated dual-diffuse directional lighting on slate (`#1e2126`). Eliminates corneal light bleed, harsh 1px tacky borders, and high-contrast glare that cause severe eyestrain.

Slate #1e2126 Zero Halation Soft Shadows

Dynamic Island & Audio HUD

Real-time audio visualizer waves, playback transport deck, and acoustic sound feedback synthesized with Web Audio API for tactile user interactions.

Dynamic Island Web Audio Chimes Visualizer

Slash Commands & Telemetry

Execute instant terminal actions with `/music`, `/install `, `/status`, `/model`. Monitored 24/7 with Arize Phoenix OpenTelemetry tracing on port 6006.

Slash Macros Arize Phoenix Flathub

System Blueprint

Edge-to-Container Architecture

A robust microservice architecture designed for zero latency and rock-solid persistence.

1. Edge Clients

GitHub Pages static SPA, Local Ingress (:80/:5173), Android Native Bridge

2. Ingress & Tunnel

Caddy 2 & Cloudflare Zero Trust Tunnel routing WSS and REST endpoints

3. FastAPI Core

Socrates Reasoning Loop, MPRIS Bridge, Arize Phoenix Tracing (:6006)

4. Container SQLite3

`andromeda.db` WAL volume, PBKDF2 tokens, user-scoped sessions & memory
